title: Mac Quack
blurb: The Mac quack — the actual duck quack that classic Macintosh computers shipped as an alert sound. Decades before notification design became a science, Apple gave the world a computer that quacked at errors, and honestly, nothing since has improved on it. Retro-computing gold: play it for mistakes that deserve whimsy instead of alarm.
origin: The classic Macintosh 'Quack' system alert from vintage Mac OS.
